source_quote.quote: Cohort A: relapsed/refractory non-brainstem CNS primary tumor AND tumor is B7-H3 positive
Has a diagnosis of diffuse midline glioma that harbors a mutation associated with this entity (e.g. H3K27M)

coder_notes: Paediatric/young adult (age <=21; stdAges CHILD, ADULT -> mixed_age) Phase 1 of B7-H3 CAR T cells; cell therapy is an excluded intervention type, so no candidate. Population is multiple primary CNS tumours including several glioma types; glioblastoma named only in conditions; coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named (alternatively basket_gbm_eligible as a multi-CNS-tumour trial; both include). B7-H3 is required for Cohort A (and is one of alternative criteria for non-pontine DMG in Cohort B); it is mechanistically linked to the B7-H3 CAR T product, but that product is not a candidate, so candidate_matched false. H3K27M is one of alternative entry routes for Cohort B (DMG, not GBM). Treatment setting: Cohort A relapsed/refractory; Cohort B post-radiation DMG not stated to be recurrent, so coded both. formulation_flag new_route for locoregional intraventricular delivery.
